verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Al-hamdu Lillaahil-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wa ja'alaz-zulumaati wan-noora thummal-ladheena kafaroo birabbihim ya'diloon
Huwal-ladhee khalaqakum min teenin thumma qadaa ajalan wa ajalun musamman indahu thumma antum tamtaroon
Wa huwallaahu fis-samaawaati wa fil-ardi ya'lamu sirrakum wa jahrakum wa ya'lamu maa taksiboon
Wa maa ta'teehim min aayatin min aayaati rabbihim illaa kaanoo anhaa mu'rideen
Faqad kadhdhaboo bil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum fasawfa ya'teehim anbaa'u maa kaanoo bihi yastahzi'oon

Alam yaraw kam ahlaknaa min qablihim min qarnin makkannaahum fil-ardi maa lam numakkin lakum wa arsalnas-samaa'a alayhim midraaran wa ja'alnal-anhaara tajree min tahtihim fa-ahlaknaahum bidhunoobihim wa ansha'naa min ba'dihim qarnan aakhareen
Wa law nazzalnaa alayka kitaaban fee qirtaasin falamasoohu bi-aydeehim laqaalal-ladheena kafaroo in haadhaa illaa sihrun mubeen
Wa qaaloo lawlaa unzila alayhi malakun wa law anzalnaa malakan laqudiyal-amru thumma laa yunzaroon
Wa law ja'alnaahu malakan laja'alnaahu rajulan wa lalabasnaa alayhim maa yalbisoon
Wa laqadi ustuhzi'a birusulin min qablika fahaaqa billadheena sakhiroo minhum maa kaanoo bihi yastahzi'oon
Qul seeroo fil-ardi thumma unzuroo kayfa kaana aaqibatul-mukadhdhibeen
Qul liman maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi qul Lillaahi kataba alaa nafsihir-rahmata layajma'annakum ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati laa rayba feehil-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum fahum laa yu'minoon
Wa lahu maa sakana fil-layli wan-nahaari wa huwas-samee'ul-aleem
Qul aghayra Allaahi attakhidhu waliyyan faatiris-samaawaati wal-ardi wa huwa yut'imu wa laa yut'amu qul innee umirtu an akoona awwala man aslama wa laa takoonanna minal-mushrikeen
Qul innee akhaafu in asaytu rabbee adhaaba yawmin azeem
Man yusraf anhu yawma'idhin faqad rahimahu wa dhaalikal-fawzul-mubeen
Wa in yamsaska Allaahu bidurrin falaa kaashifa lahu illaa huwa wa in yamsaska bikhayrin fahuwa alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wa huwal-qaahiru fawqa ibaadihi wa huwal-hakeemul-khabeer

Qul ayyu shay'in akbaru shahaadatan quli Allaahu shaheedun baynee wa baynakum wa oohiya ilayya haadhal-qur'aanu li'ndhirakum bihi wa man balagha a'innakum latashhadoona anna ma'a Allaahi aalihatan ukhraa qul laa ashhadu qul innamaa huwa ilaahun waahidun wa innanee baree'un mimmaa tushrikoon
Al-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba ya'rifoonahu kamaa ya'rifoona abnaa'ahumul-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum fahum laa yu'minoon
Wa man azlamu mimmani iftaraa alaa Allaahi kadhiban aw kadhdhaba bi-aayaatihi innahu laa yuflihuz-zaalimoon
Wa yawma nahshuruhum jamee'an thumma naqoolu lilladheena ashrakoo ayna shurakaa'uukumul-ladheena kuntum taz'umoon
Thumma lam takun fitnatuhum illaa an qaaloo Wallaahi rabbinaa maa kunnaa mushrikeen
Unzur kayfa kadhaboo alaa anfusihim wa dalla anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon

Wa minhum man yastami'u ilayka wa ja'alnaa alaa quloobihim akinnatan an yafqahoohu wa fee aadhaanihim waqran wa in yaraw kulla aayatin laa yu'minoo bihaa hattaa idhaa jaa'ooka yujaadiloonaka yaqoolul-ladheena kafaroo in haadhaa illaa asaateerul-awwaleen
Wa hum yanhawna anhu wa yan'awna anhu wa in yuhlikoona illaa anfusahum wa maa yash'uroon
Wa law taraa idh wuqifoo alan-naari faqaaloo yaa laytanaa nuraddu wa laa nukadhdhiba bi-aayaati rabbinaa wa nakoona minal-mu'mineen
Bal badaa lahum maa kaanoo yukhfoona min qablu wa law ruddoo la-aadoo limaa nuhoo anhu wa innahum lakaadhiboon
Wa qaaloo in hiya illaa hayaatunad-dunyaa wa maa nahnu bimab'ootheen
Wa law taraa idh wuqifoo alaa rabbihim qaala alaysa haadhaa bil-haqqi qaaloo balaa wa rabbinaa qaala fadhooqul-adhaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon

Qad khasiral-ladheena kadhdhaboo biliqaa'i Allaahi hattaa idhaa jaa'athumus-saa'atu baghtatan qaaloo yaa hasratanaa alaa maa farratnaa feehaa wa hum yahmiloona awzaarahum alaa zuhoorihim alaa saa'a maa yaziroon
Wa mal-hayaatud-dunyaa illaa la-ibun wa lahwun wa lalddaarul-aakhiratu khayrun lilladheena yattaqoona afalaa ta'qiloon
Qad na'lamu innahu layahzunukal-ladhee yaqooloona fa-innahum laa yukadhdhiboonaka wa laakinnaz-zaalimeena bi-aayaati Allaahi yajhadoon
Wa laqad kudhdhibat rusulun min qablika fasabaroo alaa maa kudhdhiboo wa oodhoo hattaa ataahum nasrunaa wa laa mubaddila likalimaati Allaahi wa laqad jaa'aka min naba'il-mursaleen

Wa in kaana kabura alayka i'raaduhum fa-ini istata'ta an tabtaghiya nafaqan fil-ardi aw sullaman fis-samaa'i fata'tiyahum bi-aayatin wa law shaa'a Allaahu lajama'ahum alal-hudaa falaa takoonanna minal-jaahileen
Innamaa yastajeebul-ladheena yasma'oona wal-mawtaa yab'athuhumu Allaahu thumma ilayhi yurja'oon
Wa qaaloo lawlaa nuzzila alayhi aayatun min rabbihi qul innallaaha qaadirun alaa an yunazzila aayatan wa laakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Wa maa min daabbatin fil-ardi wa laa taa'irin yateeru bijanaahayhi illaa umamun amthaalukum maa farratnaa fil-kitaabi min shay'in thumma ilaa rabbihim yuhsharoon
Wal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa summun wa bukmun fiz-zulumaati man yasha'i Allaahu yudlilhu wa man yasha yaj'alhu alaa siraatin mustaqeem
Qul ara'aytakum in ataakum adhaabu Allaahi aw atatkumus-saa'atu aghayra Allaahi tad'oona in kuntum saadiqeen
Bal iyyaahu tad'oona fayakshifu maa tad'oona ilayhi in shaa'a wa tansawna maa tushrikoon
Wa laqad arsalnaa ilaa umamin min qablika fa-akhadhnaahum bil-ba'saa'i wad-darraa'i la-allahum yatadarra'oon
Falawlaa idh jaa'ahum ba'sunaa tadarra'oo wa laakin qasat quloobuhum wa zayyana lahumush-shaytaanu maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Falammaa nasoo maa dhukkiroo bihi fatahnaa alayhim abwaaba kulli shay'in hattaa idhaa farihoo bimaa ootoo akhadhnaahum baghtatan fa-idhaa hum mublisoon
Faquti'a daabirul-qawmil-ladheena zalamoo wal-hamdu Lillaahi rabbil-aalameen
Qul ara'aytum in akhadha Allaahu sam'akum wa absaarakum wa khatama alaa quloobikum man ilaahun ghayru Allaahi ya'teekum bihin-zur kayfa nusarriful-aayaati thumma hum yasdifoon
Qul ara'aytakum in ataakum adhaabu Allaahi baghtatan aw jahratan hal yuhlaku illal-qawmuz-zaalimoon
Wa maa nursilul-mursaleena illaa mubashshireena wa mundhireena faman aamana wa aslaha falaa khawfun alayhim wa laa hum yahzanoon
Wal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa yamassuhumul-adhaabu bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
Qul laa aqoolu lakum indee khazaa'inu Allaahi wa laa a'lamul-ghayba wa laa aqoolu lakum innee malakun in attabi'u illaa maa yoohaa ilayya qul hal yastawil-a'maa wal-baseeru afalaa tatafakkaroon
Wa andhir bihil-ladheena yakhaafoona an yuhsharoo ilaa rabbihim laysa lahum min doonihi waliyyun wa laa shafee'un la-allahum yattaqoon

Wa laa tatrudil-ladheena yad'oona rabbahum bil-ghadaati wal-ashiyyi yureedoona wajhahu maa alayka min hisaabihim min shay'in wa maa min hisaabika alayhim min shay'in fatatrudahum fatakoona minaz-zaalimeen
Wa kadhalika fatannaa ba'dahum biba'din liyaqooloo ahaa'uulaa manna Allaahu alayhim min bayninaa alaysa Allaahu bi-a'lama bish-shaakireen

Wa idhaa jaa'akal-ladheena yu'minoona bi-aayaatinaa faqul salaamun alaykum kataba rabbukum alaa nafsihir-rahmata annahu man amila minkum soo'an bijahaalatin thumma taaba min ba'dihi wa aslaha fa-annahu ghafoorun Raheem
Wa kadhalika nufassilul-aayaati wa litastabeena sabeelul-mujrimeen
Qul innee nuheetu an a'budal-ladheena tad'oona min doonillaahi qul laa attabi'u ahwaa'akum qad dalaltu idhan wa maa anaa minal-muhtadeen
Qul innee alaa bayyinatin min rabbee wa kadhdhabtum bihi maa indee maa tasta'jiloona bihi inil-hukmu illaa Lillaahi yaqussul-haqqa wa huwa khayrul-faasileen
Qul law anna indee maa tasta'jiloona bihi laqudiyal-amru baynee wa baynakum Wallaahu a'lamu biz-zaalimeen

Wa indahu mafaatihul-ghaybi laa ya'lamuhaa illaa huwa wa ya'lamu maa fil-barri wal-bahri wa maa tasqutu min waraqatin illaa ya'lamuhaa wa laa habbatin fee zulumaatil-ardi wa laa ratbin wa laa yaa bisin illaa fee kitaabin mubeen
Wa huwal-ladhee yatawaffaakum bil-layli wa ya'lamu maa jarahtum bin-nahaari thumma yab'athukum feehi liyuqdaa ajalun musamman thumma ilayhi marji'ukum thumma yunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
Wa huwal-qaahiru fawqa ibaadihi wa yursilu alaykum hafazatan hattaa idhaa jaa'a ahadakumul-mawtu tawaffathu rusulunaa wa hum laa yufarritoon
Thumma ruddoo ilaa Allaahi mawlaahumul-haqqi alaa lahul-hukmu wa huwa asra'ul-haasibeen
Qul man yunajjeekum min zulumaatil-barri wal-bahri tad'oonahu tadarru'an wa khufyatan la-in anjaanaa min haadhihi lanakoonanna minash-shaakireen
Quli Allaahu yunajjeekum minhaa wa min kulli karbin thumma antum tushrikoon
Qul huwal-qaadiru alaa an yab'atha alaykum adhaaban min fawqikum aw min tahti arjulikum aw yalbisakum shiya'an wa yudheeqa ba'dakum ba'sa ba'din unzur kayfa nusarriful-aayaati la-allahum yafqahoon
Wa kadhdhaba bihi qawmuka wa huwal-haqqu qul lastu alaykum biwakeel
Likulli naba'iin mustaqarrun wa sawfa ta'lamoon
Wa idhaa ra'aytal-ladheena yakhoodoona fee aayaatinaa fa-a'rid anhum hattaa yakhoodoo fee hadeethin ghayrihi wa immaa yunsiyannakash-shaytaanu falaa taq'ud ba'dadh-dhikraa ma'al-qawmiz-zaalimeen
Wa maa alal-ladheena yattaqoona min hisaabihim min shay'in wa laakin dhikraa la-allahum yattaqoon

Wa dharil-ladheena ittakhadhoo deenahum la-iban wa lahwan wa gharrathumul-hayaatud-dunyaa wa dhakkir bihi an tubsala nafsun bimaa kasabat laysa lahaa min doonillaahi waliyyun wa laa shafee'un wa in ta'dil kulla adlin laa yu'ukhadh minhaa ulaa'ikal-ladheena ubsiloo bimaa kasaboo lahum sharaabun min hameemin wa adhaabun aleemun bimaa kaanoo yakfuroon

Qul anad'oo min doonillaahi maa laa yanfa'unaa wa laa yadurrunaa wa nuraddu alaa a'qaabinaa ba'da idh hadaanaa Allaahu kal-ladhee istahwathush-shayaateenu fil-ardi hayraana lahu ashaabun yad'oonahu ilal-hudaa i'tinaa qul inna hudaa Allaahi huwal-hudaa wa umirnaa linuslima lirabbil-aalameen
Wa an aqeemus-salaata wattaqoohu wa huwal-ladhee ilayhi tuhsharoon
Wa huwal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqqi wa yawma yaqoolu kun fayakoonu qawluhul-haqqu wa lahul-mulku yawma yunfakhu fis-soori aalimul-ghaybi wash-shahaadati wa huwal-hakeemul-khabeer
Wa idh qaala ibraaheemu li-abeehi aazara atattakhidhu asnaaman aalihatan innee araaka wa qawmaka fee dalaalin mubeen
Wa kadhalika nuree ibraaheema malakootas-samaawaati wal-ardi wa liyakoona minal-mooqineen
Falammaa janna alayhil-laylu ra'aa kawkaban qaala haadhaa rabbee falammaa afala qaala laa uhibbul-aafileen
Falammaa ra'al-qamara baazighan qaala haadhaa rabbee falammaa afala qaala la-in lam yahdinee rabbee la-akoonanna minal-qawmid-daalleen
Falammaa ra'ash-shamsa baazighatan qaala haadhaa rabbee haadhaa akbaru falammaa afalat qaala yaa qawmi innee baree'un mimmaa tushrikoon
Innee wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhee fataras-samaawaati wal-arda haneefan wa maa anaa minal-mushrikeen
Wa haajjahu qawmuhu qaala atuhaajjoonee fee Allaahi wa qad hadaani wa laa akhaafu maa tushrikoona bihi illaa an yashaa'a rabbee shay'an wasi'a rabbee kulla shay'in ilman afalaa tatadhakkaroon
Wa kayfa akhaafu maa ashraktum wa laa takhaafoona annakum ashraktum Billaahi maa lam yunazzil bihi alaykum sultaanan fa-ayyul-fareeqayni ahaqqu bil-amni in kuntum ta'lamoon
Al-ladheena aamanoo wa lam yalbisoo eemaanahum bizulmin ulaa'ika lahumul-amnu wa hum muhtadoon
Wa tilka hujjatunaa aataynaahaa ibraaheema alaa qawmihi narfa'u darajaatin man nashaa'u inna rabbaka hakeemun aleem
Wa wahabnaa lahu ishaaqa wa ya'qooba kullan hadaynaa wa noohan hadaynaa min qablu wa min dhurriyyatihi daawooda wa sulaymaana wa ayyooba wa yoosufa wa moosaa wa haaroona wa kadhalika najzil-muhsineen
Wa zakariyyaa wa yahyaa wa eesaa wa ilyaasa kullun minas-saaliheen
Wa ismaa'eela wal-yasa'a wa yoonus wa lootan wa kullan faddalnaa alal-aalameen
Wa min aabaa'ihim wa dhurriyyaatihim wa ikhwaanihim wajtabaynaahum wa hadaynaahum ilaa siraatin mustaqeem
Dhaalika hudaa Allaahi yahdee bihi man yashaa'u min ibaadihi wa law ashrakoo lahabita anhum maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba wal-hukma wan-nubuwwata fa-in yakfur bihaa haa'ulaa'i faqad wakkalnaa bihaa qawman laysoo bihaa bikaafireen
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena hadaa Allaahu fabihudaahumu iqtadihi qul laa as'alukum alayhi ajran in huwa illaa dhikraa lil-aalameen

Wa maa qadaroo Allaaha haqqa qadrihi idh qaaloo maa anzala Allaahu alaa basharin min shay'in qul man anzalal-kitaabal-ladhee jaa'a bihi moosaa nooran wa hudan lin-naasi taj'aloonahu qaraateesa tubdoonahaa wa tukhfoona katheeran wa ullimtum maa lam ta'lamoo antum wa laa aabaa'uukum quli Allaahu thumma dharhum fee khawdihim yal-aboon

Wa haadhaa kitaabun anzalnaahu mubaarakun musaddiqul-ladhee bayna yadayhi wa litundhira ummal-quraa wa man hawlahaa wal-ladheena yu'minoona bil-aakhirati yu'minoona bihi wa hum alaa salaatihim yuhaafizoon

Wa man azlamu mimmani iftaraa alaa Allaahi kadhiban aw qaala oohiya ilayya wa lam yooha ilayhi shay'un wa man qaala sa'unzilu mithla maa anzala Allaahu wa law taraa idhiz-zaalimoona fee ghamaraatil-mawti wal-malaa'ikatu baasitoo aydeehim akhrijoo anfusakumul-yawma tujzawna adhaabal-hooni bimaa kuntum taqooloona alaa Allaahi ghayral-haqqi wa kuntum an aayaatihi tastakbiroon

Wa laqad ji'tumoonaa furaadaa kamaa khalaqnaakum awwala marratin wa taraktum maa khawwalnaakum waraa'a zuhoorikum wa maa naraa ma'akum shufa'aa'akumul-ladheena za'amtum annahum feekum shurakaa'u laqad taqatta'a baynakum wa dalla ankum maa kuntum taz'umoon
Innallaaha faaliqul-habbi wan-nawaa yukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti wa mukhrijul-mayyiti minal-hayyi dhalikumu Allaahu fa-annaa tu'ufakoon
Faaliqul-isbaahi wa ja'alal-layla sakanan wash-shamsa wal-qamara husbaanan dhaalika taqdeerul-azeezil-aleem
Wa huwal-ladhee ja'ala lakumun-nujooma litahtadoo bihaa fee zulumaatil-barri wal-bahri qad fassalnal-aayaati liqawmin ya'lamoon
Wa huwal-ladhee ansha'akum min nafsin waahidatin famustaqarrun wa mustawda'un qad fassalnal-aayaati liqawmin yafqahoon

Wa huwal-ladhee anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fa-akhrajnaa bihi nabaata kulli shay'in fa-akhrajnaa minhu khadiran nukhriju minhu habban mutaraakiban wa minan-nakhli min tal'ihaa qinwaanun daaniyatun wa jannaatin min a'naabin waz-zaytoona war-rummaana mushtabihan wa ghayra mutashaabihin unzuroo ilaa thamarihi idhaa athmara wa yan'ihi inna fee dhaalikum la-aayaatin liqawmin yu'minoon
Wa ja'aloo Lillaahi shurakaa'al-jinna wa khalaqahum wa kharaqoo lahu baneena wa banaatin bighayri ilmin subhaanahu wa ta'aalaa ammaa yasifoon
Badee'us-samaawaati wal-ardi annaa yakoonu lahu waladun wa lam takun lahu saahibatun wa khalaqa kulla shay'in wa huwa bikulli shay'in aleem
Dhalikumu Allaahu rabbukum laa ilaaha illaa huwa khaaliqu kulli shay'in fa'budoohu wa huwa alaa kulli shay'in wakeel
Laa tudrikuhul-absaaru wa huwa yudrikul-absaara wa huwal-lateeful-khabeer
Qad jaa'akum basaa'iru min rabbikum faman absara falinafsihi wa man amiya fa-alayhaa wa maa anaa alaykum bihafeez
Wa kadhalika nusarriful-aayaati wa liyaqooloo darasta wa linubayyinahu liqawmin ya'lamoon
Ittabi maa oohiya ilayka min rabbika laa ilaaha illaa huwa wa a'rid anil-mushrikeen
Wa law shaa'a Allaahu maa ashrakoo wa maa ja'alnaaka alayhim hafeezan wa maa anta alayhim biwakeel

Wa laa tasubbul-ladheena yad'oona min doonillaahi fayasubboo Allaaha adwan bighayri ilmin kadhaalika zayyannaa likulli ummatin amalahum thumma ilaa rabbihim marji'uhum fayunabbi'uhum bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
Wa aqsamoo Billaahi jahda aymaanihim la-in jaa'athum aayatun layu'minunna bihaa qul innamal-aayaatu indallaahi wa maa yush'irukum annahaa idhaa jaa'at laa yu'minoon
Wa nuqallibu af'idatahum wa absaarahum kamaa lam yu'minoo bihi awwala marratin wa nadharuhum fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
Wa law annanaa nazzalnaa ilayhimul-malaa'ikata wa kallamahumul-mawtaa wa hasharnaa alayhim kulla shay'in qubulan maa kaanoo liyu'minoo illaa an yashaa'a Allaahu wa laakinna aktharahum yajhaloon
Wa kadhalika ja'alnaa likulli nabiyyin aduwwan shayaateenal-insi wal-jinni yoohee ba'duhum ilaa ba'din zukhrufal-qawli ghurooran wa law shaa'a rabbuka maa fa-aloohu fadharhum wa maa yaftaroon
Wa litasghaa ilayhi af'idatul-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati wa liyardawhu wa liyaqtarifoo maa hum muqtarifoon

Afaghayra Allaahi abtaghee hakaman wa huwal-ladhee anzala ilaykumul-kitaaba mufassalan wal-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba ya'lamoona annahu munazzalun min rabbika bil-haqqi falaa takoonanna minal-mumtareen
Wa tammat kalimatu rabbika sidqan wa adlan laa mubaddila likalimaatihi wa huwas-samee'ul-aleem
Wa in tuti akthara man fil-ardi yudillooka an sabeelillaahi in yattabi'oona illaz-zanna wa in hum illaa yakhrusoon
Inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu man yadillu an sabeelihi wa huwa a'lamu bil-muhtadeen
Fakuloo mimmaa dhukira usmu Allaahi alayhi in kuntum bi-aayaatihi mu'mineen

Wa maa lakum allaa ta'kuloo mimmaa dhukira usmu Allaahi alayhi wa qad fassala lakum maa harrama alaykum illaa mad-turirtum ilayhi wa inna katheeran layudilloona bi-ahwaa'ihim bighayri ilmin inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu bil-mu'tadeen
Wa dharoo zaahiral-ithmi wa baatinahu innal-ladheena yaksiboonal-ithma sayujzawna bimaa kaanoo yaqtarifoon
Wa laa ta'kuloo mimmaa lam yudhkari usmu Allaahi alayhi wa innahu lafisqun wa innash-shayaateena layoohoona ilaa awliyaa'ihim liyujaadilookum wa in ata'tumoohum innakum lamushrikoon
Awaman kaana maytan fa-ahyaynaahu wa ja'alnaa lahu nooran yamshee bihi fin-naasi kaman mathaluhu fiz-zulumaati laysa bikhaarijin minhaa kadhaalika zuyyina lilkaafireena maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Wa kadhalika ja'alnaa fee kulli qaryatin akaabira mujrimeehaa liyamkuroo feehaa wa maa yamkuroona illaa bi-anfusihim wa maa yash'uroon

Wa idhaa jaa'athum aayatun qaaloo lan nu'mina hattaa nu'taa mithla maa ootiya rusulu Allaahi Allaahu a'lamu haythu yaj'alu risaalatahu sayuseebul-ladheena ajramoo saghaarun indallaahi wa adhaabun shadeedun bimaa kaanoo yamkuroon

Faman yuridi Allaahu an yahdiyahu yashrah sadrahu lil-islaami wa man yurid an yudillahu yaj'al sadrahu dayyiqan harajan ka'annamaa yassa'adu fis-samaa'i kadhaalika yaj'alu Allaahur-rijsa alal-ladheena laa yu'minoon
Wa haadhaa siraatu rabbika mustaqeeman qad fassalnal-aayaati liqawmin yadhdhakkaroon
Lahum daarus-salaami inda rabbihim wa huwa waliyyuhum bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon

Wa yawma yahshuruhum jamee'an yaa ma'sharal-jinni qadis-takthartum minal-insi wa qaala awliyaa'uuhum minal-insi rabbanaa istamta'a ba'dunaa biba'din wa balaghnaa ajalanal-ladhee ajjalta lanaa qaalan-naaru mathwaakum khaalideena feehaa illaa maa shaa'a Allaahu inna rabbaka hakeemun aleem
Wa kadhalika nuwallee ba'daz-zaalimeena ba'dan bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon

Yaa ma'sharal-jinni wal-insi alam ya'tikum rusulun minkum yaqussoona alaykum aayaa tee wa yundhiroonakum liqaa'a yawmikum haadhaa qaaloo shahidnaa alaa anfusinaa wa gharrathumul-hayaa utud-dunyaa wa shahidoo alaa anfusihim annahum kaanoo kaafireen
Dhaalika an lam yakun rabbuka muhlikal-quraa bizulmin wa ahluhaa ghaafiloon
Wa likullin darajaatun mimmaa amiloo wa maa rabbuka bighaafilin ammaa ya'maloon
Wa rabbukal-ghaniyyu dhur-rahmati in yasha yudhhibkum wa yastakhlif min ba'dikum maa yashaa'u kamaa ansha'akum min dhurriyyati qawmin aakhareen
Inna maa too'adoona la-aatin wa maa antum bimu'jizeen
Qul yaa qawmi i'maloo alaa makaanatikum innee aamilun fasawfa ta'lamoona man takoonu lahu aaqibatud-daari innahu laa yuflihuz-zaalimoon

Wa ja'aloo Lillaahi mimmaa dhara'a minal-harthi wal-an'aam naseeban faqaaloo haadhaa Lillaahi biza'mihim wa haadhaa lishurakaa'inaa famaa kaana lishurakaa'ihim falaa yasilu ilaa Allaahi wa maa kaana Lillaahi fahuwa yasilu ilaa shurakaa'ihim saa'a maa yahkumoon
Wa kadhalika zayyana likatheerin minal-mushrikeena qatla awlaadihim shurakaa'uuhum liyurdoohum wa liyalbisoo alayhim deenahum wa law shaa'a Allaahu maa fa-aloohu fadharhum wa maa yaftaroon

Wa qaaloo haadhihi an'aamun wa harthun hijrun laa yat'amuhaa illaa man nashaa'u biza'mihim wa an'aamun hurrimat zuhooruhaa wa an'aamun laa yadhkuroona isma Allaahi alayhaa iftiraa'an alayhi sayajzeehim bimaa kaanoo yaftaroon
Wa qaaloo maa fee butooni haadhihil-an'aami khaalisatun lidhukoorinaa wa muharramun alaa azwaajinaa wa in yakun maytatan fahum feehi shurakaa'u sayajzeehim wasfahum innahu hakeemun aleem
Qad khasiral-ladheena qataloo awlaadahum safahan bighayri ilmin wa harramoo maa razaqahumu Allaahu iftiraa'an alaa Allaahi qad dalloo wa maa kaanoo muhtadeen

Wa huwal-ladhee ansha'a jannaatin ma'rooshaatin wa ghayra ma'rooshaatin wan-nakhla waz-zar'a mukhtalifan ukuluhu waz-zaytoona war-rummaana mutashaabihan wa ghayra mutashaabihin kuloo min thamarihi idhaa athmara wa aatoo haqqahu yawma hasaadihi wa laa tusrifoo innahu laa yuhibbul-musrifeen
Wa minal-an'aami hamoolatan wa farshan kuloo mimmaa razaqakumu Allaahu wa laa tattabi'oo khutuwaatish-shaytaani innahu lakum aduwwun mubeen
Thamaaniyata azwaajin minad-da'ni ithnayni wa minal-ma'zi ithnayni qul aaldhdhakarayni harrama amil-unthayayni ammash-tamalat alayhi arhaamul-unthayayni nabbi'oonee bi-ilmin in kuntum saadiqeen

Wa minal-ibili ithnayni wa minal-baqari ithnayni qul aaldhdhakarayni harrama amil-unthayayni ammash-tamalat alayhi arhaamul-unthayayni am kuntum shuhadaa'a idh wassaakumu Allaahu bihadhaa faman azlamu mimmani iftaraa alaa Allaahi kadhiban liyudillan-naasa bighayri ilmin innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen

Qul laa ajidu fee maa oohiya ilayya muharraman alaa taa'imin yat'amuhu illaa an yakoona maytatan aw daman masfoohan aw lahma khinzeerin fa-innahu rijsun aw fisqan uhilla lighayri Allaahi bihi famani udturra ghayra baaghin wa laa aadin fa-inna rabbaka ghafoorun Raheem

Wa alal-ladheena haadoo harramnaa kulla dhee zufurin wa minal-baqari wal-ghanami harramnaa alayhim shuhoomahumaa illaa maa hamalat zuhooruhumaa awil-hawaayaa aw makh-talata bi-azmin dhaalika jazaynaahum bibaghyihim wa innaa lasaadiqoon
Fa-in kadhdhabooka faqul rabbukum dhoo rahmatin waasi'atin wa laa yuraddu ba'suhu anil-qawmil-mujrimeen

Sayaqoolul-ladheena ashrakoo law shaa'a Allaahu maa ashraknaa wa laa aabaa'uunaa wa laa harramnaa min shay'in kadhaalika kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim hattaa dhaaqoo ba'sanaa qul hal indakum min ilmin fatukhrijoohu lanaa in tattabi'oona illaz-zanna wa in antum illaa takhrusoon
Qul falillaahil-hujjatul-baalighatu falaw shaa'a lahadaakum ajma'een

Qul halumma shuhadaa'akumul-ladheena yashhadoona annallaaha harrama haadhaa fa-in shahidoo falaa tashhad ma'ahum wa laa tattabi ahwaa'al-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa wal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati wa hum birabbihim ya'diloon

Qul ta'aalaw atlu maa harrama rabbukum alaykum allaa tushrikoo bihi shay'an wa bil-waalidayni ihsaanan wa laa taqtuloo awlaadakum min imlaaqin nahnu narzuqukum wa iyyaahum wa laa taqrabul-fawaahisha maa zahara minhaa wa maa batana wa laa taqtulun-nafsal-latee harrama Allaahu illaa bil-haqqi dhaalikum wassaakum bihi la-allakum ta'qiloon

Wa laa taqraboo maalal-yateemi illaa billatee hiya ahsanu hattaa yablugha ashuddahu wa awful-kayla wal-meezaana bil-qisti laa nukallifu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa wa idhaa qultum fa'diloo wa law kaana dhaa qurbaa wa bi-ahdi Allaahi awfoo dhaalikum wassaakum bihi la-allakum tadhakkaroon
Wa anna haadhaa siraatee mustaqeeman fattabi'oohu wa laa tattabi'us-subula fatafarraqa bikum an sabeelihi dhaalikum wassaakum bihi la-allakum tattaqoon
Thumma aataynaa moosal-kitaaba tamaaman alal-ladhee ahsana wa tafseelan likulli shay'in wa hudan wa rahmatan la-allahum biliqaa'i rabbihim yu'minoon
Wa haadhaa kitaabun anzalnaahu mubaarakun fattabi'oohu wattaqoo la-allakum turhamoon
An taqooloo innamaa unzilal-kitaabu alaa taa'ifatayni min qablinaa wa in kunnaa an diraasatihim laghaafileen

Aw taqooloo law annaa unzila alaynal-kitaabu lakunnaa ahdaa minhum faqad jaa'akum bayyinatun min rabbikum wa hudan wa rahmatun faman azlamu mimman kadhdhaba bi-aayaati Allaahi wa sadafa anhaa sanajzil-ladheena yasdifoona an aayaatinaa soo'al-adhaabi bimaa kaanoo yasdifoon

Hal yanzuroona illaa an ta'tiyahumul-malaa'ikatu aw ya'tiya rabbuka aw ya'tiya ba'du aayaati rabbika yawma ya'tee ba'du aayaati rabbika laa yanfa'u nafsan eemaanuhaa lam takun aamanat min qablu aw kasabat fee eemaanihaa khayran qul intaziroo innaa muntaziroon
Innal-ladheena farraqoo deenahum wa kaanoo shiya'an lasta minhum fee shay'in innamaa amruhum ilaa Allaahi thumma yunabbi'uhum bimaa kaanoo yaf'aloon
Man jaa'a bil-hasanati falahu ashru amthaalihaa wa man jaa'a bis-sayyi'ati falaa yujzaa illaa mithlahaa wa hum laa yuzlamoon
Qul innanee hadaanee rabbee ilaa siraatin mustaqeemin deenan qiyaman millata ibraaheema haneefan wa maa kaana minal-mushrikeen
Qul inna salaatee wa nusukee wa mahyaaya wa mamaatee Lillaahi rabbil-aalameen
Laa shareeka lahu wa bidhalika umirtu wa anaa awwalul-muslimeen

Qul aghayra Allaahi abghee rabban wa huwa rabbu kulli shay'in wa laa taksibu kullu nafsin illaa alayhaa wa laa taziru waaziratun wizra ukhraa thumma ilaa rabbikum marji'ukum fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
Wa huwal-ladhee ja'alakum khalaa'ifal-ardi wa rafa'a ba'dakum fawqa ba'din darajaatin liyabluwakum fee maa aataakum inna rabbaka saree'ul-iqaabi wa innahu laghafoorun Raheem
